17-star_pose06_twin_overhead_SAFE.txt: kneeling upright back on her heels in the shallow circular tub, spine arched gently: BOTH arms raised high in a wide V, one hand holding each golden decanter tipped out above her, so TWO thin unbroken streams of glittering water fall from both sides at once onto the gold clasps at her chest, meeting and spreading over the covered bust in a bright glittering veil of falling water, fanning into rivulets that trace down her ribs, waist and hips before rejoining the tub water, her head tipped gently BACK and up, chin lifted, starlight grey-blue eyes drooping blissfully HALF-CLOSED behind low lashes, lips softly parted, water beading on her lashes.
17-star_pose07_profile_pour_SAFE.txt: kneeling in FULL PROFILE in the shallow circular tub, her silhouette edged in starlight against the glass-dome skylight, spine a soft arch: ONE arm raised in a high bent arc, hand holding the first golden decanter tipped out just above her so a thin unbroken stream falls over the top of her bikini and the gold clasps in a bright sheet of falling water, running down the front of her body in glistening trails; her OTHER arm extends low and open BEHIND her, hand holding the second golden decanter tipped so its thin stream spills into the tub; in profile her head tips gently back, chin lifted to the skylight, starlight grey-blue eyes drooping half-closed behind low lashes, a serene half-smile.
17-star_pose08_waterline_recline_SAFE.tx: lying back in the shallow circular tub, half-submerged, one knee softly risen: ONE arm raised straight up, hand holding the first golden decanter tipped out above her chest so a thin unbroken stream falls over her covered chest and the gold clasps in a glittering veil of falling water; above the waterline her shoulders and throat glisten with falling droplets, below it her waist and hips melt into the water's refracted depths; her OTHER hand rests the second golden decanter against the rim beside her, tipped so its thin stream trickles into the water; head tipped gently back against the wet rim, throat tilted to the skylight, starlight grey-blue eyes drooping half-closed behind low lashes, lips softly parted.
17-star_pose09_shoulder_pour_SAFE.txt: kneeling in the shallow circular tub with her back turned three-quarters away from the viewer, her near cheek visible in soft profile as her head tips gently back and up toward the glass-dome skylight, starlight grey-blue eyes drooping half-closed behind low lashes, lips softly parted: her FAR arm bends up gracefully over her head, hand holding the first golden decanter tipped so its thin unbroken stream of glittering water falls past her shoulder and spreads across the wet satin front of her bikini top in a bright veil of falling water, half-hidden behind the curve of her back and shoulder as it runs down her front in glistening trails; her NEAR hand holds the second golden decanter low at her hip, tipped so its thin stream spills quietly into the tub; her long wet platinum hair plastered along her spine like a silver veil.
17-star_pose10_rim_lean_SAFE.txt: kneeling at the inner curve of the tub leaning forward over the wet rim toward the viewer, shoulder blades drawing together: ONE arm raised in a soft bent arc, hand holding the first golden decanter tipped out above her chest so a thin unbroken stream falls over her covered chest and the gold clasps in a bright fan of falling water between the wet platinum curtains of her hair, dripping in sparkling threads down toward the tub; her OTHER hand rests the second golden decanter on the rim beside her, tipped so its stream trickles into the tub; even leaning forward her head tips gently back and up, chin lifted, starlight grey-blue eyes drooping half-closed behind low lashes, lips softly parted.
